ValidationRule.description: If a CS rep attempts to close a ‘Non-order’ Case without selecting a value from the Case Cause picklist, an error message should be given
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT(ISCHANGED( IME_SC_Owner_Manager__c )), NOT(ISCHANGED( IME_SC_Manager_of_Manager_OwnerId__c )), $User.ProfileId <> "00e80000001OOVl", RecordTypeId = "01280000000UGoY", ISPICKVAL(IME_SC_Request_Type__c, "Non-order"), ISPICKVAL(Status, "Closed"), ISPICKVAL(IME_SC_Case_Cause__c,"") )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: All non-order CS Cases require a Case Cause value. Please select an appropriate value from the picklist.
